cohort: 72 pregnant women carrying fetuses with abdominal wall defects and a gestational age less than 25 weeks.
finding: Fetuses with abdominal wall defects (AWDs) had smaller 3D lung volumes than normal fetuses, and in omphalocele cases, smaller lung volume was associated with increased neonatal mortality and morbidity.
gest_age: Less than 25 weeks at inclusion, with antenatal measurements up to 33 weeks.
